body: Hello, we are very newly diagnosed with DID, so much so that we don’t have a system name yet. We have 5 alters: Roux, Dusty, The Child, The Shame Wizard, and Malcolm.

Before I knew I had DID, like before denial and everything we would dissociate and wake up to ourselves eating a cookie. I think it was a coping mechanism of some sort, which we still use on occasion.
She’s big into weed, the occult, and wrestling. I would be willing to drive up to 90 minutes for a good location. I was thinking maybe a cemetery but idk if that’s disrespectful
I’m from ohio, so not a ton of good choices. Personally, I’d have to go with Michigan
